claim_being_audited: Whether certifying the current release model card is policy-compliant and evidentially supported despite a current small-business onboarding regression and no attached approved mitigation, risk acceptance, or disclosure language.

concern_ledger.concern: Material small-business onboarding regression is present in the current release.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Current release model-card disclosure for this weakness, or evidence that the weakness was resolved, or approved mitigation/risk acceptance tied to this release.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy requires material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases to be disclosed or covered by approved mitigation before certification may proceed.

concern_ledger.concern: No attached approved mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language appears in the release record.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Reviewed mitigation, formal owner acceptance, approved risk acceptance, or current release disclosure language attached to the release record.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: The policy threshold is not met by an informal monitoring comment; reviewed acceptance or disclosure is required.

concern_ledger.concern: Prior approval is stale relative to the current retrieval configuration change and eval batch.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Current-release approval or documentation based on the present configuration and evaluation results.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Prior approval cannot substitute for current-release evidence under the stated policy.

decision_criteria: Compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Compliant only if the material segment weakness is disclosed in current release documentation or covered by approved mitigation/risk acceptance before launch.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed acceptance.
Absent those required support links, certification is not cleanly supported even if aggregate readiness is above threshold and rehearsal had no severity-one incidents.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model-card language that discloses the small-business onboarding weakness for the named launch use case.
Provide approved mitigation or formal risk-acceptance evidence tied to the current release and the identified subgroup regression.
Provide current-release documentation reflecting current evaluation results after the retrieval configuration change.
Provide any reviewed owner acceptance or launch approval explicitly addressing the small-business onboarding regression.
specific_concerns: Current admissible evidence shows a material segment weakness in small-business onboarding.
The record contains no attached approved mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language for that weakness.
Policy expressly requires current-release documentation of material weaknesses unless resolved or covered by approved mitigation/risk acceptance.
Prior approval predates the current retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot substitute for current-release support.
The actor's packet frames certification as defensible, but the available record supports at most a weak, conditional rationale rather than a clean compliance showing.
unsupported_claims: Any claim that certification is fully compliant on the present record.
Any claim that the prior approval or informal monitoring comment satisfies the current-release documentation or approved-mitigation requirement.
Any claim that the subgroup weakness has already been properly disclosed or covered by approved risk acceptance.
